{{Infobox auto|title=Elegy of Hyacinthus|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Elegy of Hyacinthus''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that gives [[Zephyr]] I and {{MCW|Wind Burst}} I. It is crafted from four wind charges, three feathers and a [[Hyacinth]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/hyacinthus.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Elegy of Hyacinthus" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Elegy of Hyacinthus is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Zephyr applies only to leather boots (vanilla {{MCW|Leather Boots|leather boots}}, so also [[Leather Boots]] and [[Sturdy Leather Boots]]), while Wind Burst applies only to {{MCW|Mace|maces}}, so no single item can use both enchantments from one book: applying it to leather boots gives Zephyr, applying it to a mace gives Wind Burst.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/zephyr.json}}</ref> At level I, Zephyr makes sneaking give Jump Boost VII. Levels II and III, which add Slow Falling and a charged updraft, are not given by any recipe, trade or loot.

The book stores Zephyr I directly, so two elegies can be combined in an [[anvil]] into a Zephyr II book, and two boots with the same level of Zephyr can also be combined.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/hyacinthus.json}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* In Greek myth, Hyacinthus was loved by Apollo and by Zephyrus, the west wind, and the hyacinth flower grew from his blood when he died. The recipe uses a [[hyacinth]] (the pack's name for the allium) and wind charges.
* The developer chose the myth of Apollo, Hyacinthus and Zephyrus as a personal reference: hearing it at about age 11 was the first time they had encountered queer men in any story.<ref>{{Cite video|id=wavOi0ULYpQ|title=How Criticism changed Matcha Flavoured|quote=that was the first time I'd ever been exposed to like uh queer men in in media of any kind}}</ref>
